_comment: Floor passages: a cell that moves whoever stops on it to another map. For the maps that
need a way out and have no element to hang a passage off -- the client only lets a
player click what its own map data has (see teleports.json). Nothing is declared to the
client, so the cell looks like any other: put one only where the map's drawing already
A cell that already has an element's passage keeps that one. This is a file of its own
and not a list in teleports.json because Jondo Studio's passage editor rewrites that
file whole, with only the passages it knows.

removed.why: Travelers' Tower, Prisión: the cell its teleporter is used from. Dofus 2's way down to 130155009 moved whoever went to use it there, and the teleporter's choice arrived on the wrong map.
Travelers' Tower: Dofus 2's way back up to the Prisión, on the same cell as its teleporter's.
Travelers' Tower, Prisión: Dofus 2's stairs to the Sala de información, a room its teleporters join in Dofus 3.

passages.why: Dyna Mine [10,-19], «Attention à la Bête !»: the slab before the trap's gallery opens its grille once the six baits are laid (4680), and the character hides in the trap room until the creature is down (4673); Dofus pour les noobs: «placez votre personnage sur la dalle pour ouvrir la grille et entrez dans la pièce».

Isle of Moon, Tortuga beach [35,5]: the hole in the wrecked ship's hull (cells 255, 269), which Kar Ybe complains everybody takes for a door; the sand below it (284) lets in. The client has no element there and its graph no passage.

Isle of Moon, path of skulls [32,4]: the wreck's doorway under the hanging frame (244, 258); «Entrez dans l'épave de bateau» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Sur les traces des Moonies»). No element outside and no passage in the client's graph.
